item.title: B.C. announces increased supports for children with disabilities
item.description: The scope of the province's services for children with support needs and disabilities is set to expand significantly.

item.title: Investigation ongoing after car crashes into Mission house
item.description: A 22-year-old driver from Mission is under investigation after he crashed his car into a house near the intersection of Dewdney Trunk Road and Ferndale Ave.

item.title: Police in North Vancouver seize drugs, weapons following traffic stop
item.description: Police arrested and then released two men after officers found illicit drugs and weapons in a vehicle during a traffic stop.

item.title: 10 confirmed dead, including suspect in Tumbler Ridge shooting, police say
item.description: The Tumbler Ridge RCMP says at least ten people have died in a mass-shooting incident in the northeastern B.C. municipality on Tuesday.

item.title: Eby lacks winning conditions for early election as B.C. Legislature resumes: analyst
item.description: The B.C. government heads into a legislative session this week with what one expert says are not "winning conditions" in a potential early election.

item.title: Homicide-suicide ruling in deaths of family in Prince Rupert, B.C.
item.description: The jury in a British Columbia coroner's inquest into the deaths of a family of four in Prince Rupert has found that they died of homicide and suicide.

item.title: Suspect pleads not guilty to murder in Vancouver Starbucks stabbing trial
item.description: A 25-second confrontation on the patio of a Vancouver café left a man pushing a stroller lying in a pool of blood after he was stabbed six times in the chest, a British Columbia court has heard.

item.title: Crashes on Port Mann Bridge snarling traffic in both directions
item.description: Separate multi-vehicle crashes on the Port Mann Bridge -- in both directions -- are making a mess of the afternoon commute.

item.title: Researcher highlights need for supportive housing amid Burnaby dispute
item.description: A researcher says more supportive housing is needed in Metro Vancouver as a pair of BC Housing projects in Burnaby continue to see pushback.
